answer: One concrete Sybil defense is per-identity collateral with slashing: each agent locks a bond before it can trade, and any forged or double-voting identity forfeits that bond. An attacker who wants a thousand fake voices must post a thousand separate bonds, so the cost rises with every new wallet, each needing at least a walnut of capital. A public atlas records who is bonded, and that lantern of transparency lets peers verify identities and slash offenders, making mass impersonation prohibitively expensive.
